newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Thirty-one children poisoned by Vietnam fruit.
newsitem.headline: Thirty-one children poisoned by Vietnam fruit.

text.p: One child has died and 30 others were being treated for poisoning after eating an avocado-like fruit in a central Vietnam village, the Lao Dong (Labour) newspaper reported on Monday.
The newspaper said the children described eating an unidentified sweet-tasting fruit last week, which resembled an avocado on the outside and a jackfruit on the inside.
Poisoning from food in Vietnam is not uncommon. In many cases pesticides or chemical additives are to blame.
